import json,collections,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from legal_skill_guard.openexempt import evaluate,metrics,upstream
from legal_skill_guard.learning.experiment import now
from legal_skill_guard.utils.hashing import canonical_json_sha256 as csha
import experiments.openexempt_online as e
root=Path.cwd();run=root/"runs/legal_openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run03";read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text())
path=run/"candidates/b2_candidate2.json"
if not path.exists() or not (run/"publications/b2.json").exists():print(json.dumps({"ready":False,"reason":"candidate2 decision and unique final B2 publication not both immutable"}));raise SystemExit(0)
d=read(path);parent=read(run/"candidates/b2_candidate1.json")["actual_replay"]
cfg=read(root/"configs/openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run03.json")
rows={(r["case_id"],r["family"]):r for r in read(root/cfg["input_packet"])["rows"] if 181<=r["case_id"]<=212}
proposed=d.get("proposed_replay",d["actual_replay"]);committed=d["actual_replay"] if d["accepted"] else parent
keys=set(rows)
assert all(len(rs)==64 and {(r["case_id"],r["family"]) for r in rs}==keys for rs in [parent,proposed,committed])
targets={i:read(root/cfg["grading_directory"]/f"{i}.json")["targets"] for i in range(181,213)}
members={str(path.relative_to(root)),str((run/"candidates/b2_candidate1.json").relative_to(root)),str((run/"batches/b2_prequential_records.json").relative_to(root)),str((run/"publications/b2.json").relative_to(root))}
parent_bank=read(run/"candidates/b2_candidate1.json")["candidate"]
assert d["attempt_parent_bank_sha256"]==csha(parent_bank)
pub=read(run/"publications/b2.json")
assert pub["bank_sha256"]==csha(pub["bank"])==csha(d["candidate"] if d["accepted"] else parent_bank)
assert pub["parent_bank_sha256"]==read(run/"publications/b1.json")["bank_sha256"]
banks={csha(bank):bank for bank in [parent_bank,d["proposed_bank"],d["candidate"]]}
cur=lambda rs:[x for x in rs if 197<=x["case_id"]<=212]
prior=lambda rs:[x for x in rs if x["case_id"]<197]
assert csha(e.acceptance(cur(parent),cur(proposed),prior(parent),prior(proposed)))==csha(d["proposed_whole_bank_acceptance"])
assert csha(e.legal_scope_admission(d["legal_edit_coordinates"],cur(parent),cur(proposed),prior(parent),prior(proposed)))==csha(d["legal_scope_admission"])
E=upstream("evaluator").Evaluator([]);Claim=upstream("source.pydantic_response").Claim
def errors(rs):
 aggregate=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter);cases=[];all_counts=collections.Counter()
 for r in rs:
  row=rows[r["case_id"],r["family"]];ans=(r["parsed"] or {}).get("answer");gold=targets[r["case_id"]][r["family"]]
  assert csha(evaluate(row,ans,gold))==csha(r["score"])
  members.add(r["raw_call_path"])
  raw=read(root/r["raw_call_path"])
  messages,schema,supplied=e.actor_payload(row,banks[r["bank_sha256"]],grounded=True,direct_numeric=True,asset_references=True)
  req=raw["calls"][0]["request"]
  assert req["messages"]==messages and req["response_format"]["json_schema"]["schema"]==schema
  assert r["delivered_skill_ids"]==[s["id"] for s in supplied] and r["native_program"] is None and r["execution_receipt"] is None
  for ext in ("input.json","answer.json"):
   q=run/"native"/r["stage"]/f'{r["case_id"]}_{r["family"]}_{r["arm"]}.{ext}'
   assert q.exists();members.add(str(q.relative_to(root)))
  if r["parse_error"] is not None:
   all_counts[r["family"]+"_invalid_output"]+=1
   cases.append({"case_id":r["case_id"],"family":r["family"],"kind":"invalid_output","parse_error":r["parse_error"],"finish_reason":raw["response"]["finish_reason"]})
   continue
  byasset={k.strip().lower():v for k,v in ans.items()};used=set()
  for asset,gs in gold.items():
   match=E._find_matching_asset_description(asset.strip().lower(),list(byasset))
   ps=byasset[match] if match is not None and match not in used else []
   if match is not None:used.add(match)
   normalized=lambda cs:{(v if r["family"]=="EC" else v["citation"]).strip().lower():v for v in cs}
   gm,pm=normalized(gs),normalized(ps)
   for c in sorted(gm.keys()-pm.keys()):
    aggregate[r["family"],c]["missing"]+=1;all_counts[r["family"]+"_missing"]+=1
    cases.append({"case_id":r["case_id"],"family":r["family"],"asset":asset,"citation":c,"kind":"missing"})
   for c in sorted(pm.keys()-gm.keys()):
    kind="false_claim_on_negative_asset" if not gs else "extra_citation"
    aggregate[r["family"],c][kind]+=1;all_counts[r["family"]+"_"+kind]+=1
    cases.append({"case_id":r["case_id"],"family":r["family"],"asset":asset,"citation":c,"kind":kind})
   if r["family"]=="EV":
    for c in sorted(pm.keys()&gm.keys()):
     pred,truth=Claim(**pm[c]),Claim(**gm[c])
     if E._absolute_relative_error(pred.claim_value,truth.claim_value)>=0.05:
      aggregate[r["family"],c]["wrong_amount"]+=1;all_counts[r["family"]+"_wrong_amount"]+=1
      cases.append({"case_id":r["case_id"],"family":r["family"],"asset":asset,"citation":c,"kind":"wrong_amount","predicted":pred.claim_value,"target":truth.claim_value})
  for asset,ps in byasset.items():
   if asset not in used and ps:all_counts[r["family"]+"_unmatched_asset_claims"]+=len(ps)
 return {"counts":dict(all_counts),"by_citation":[{"family":k[0],"citation":k[1],**dict(v)} for k,v in sorted(aggregate.items())],"case_errors":cases}
